```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "fr_FR.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "Europe/Paris"))
source(here::here("code/meteo.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      dpi = 150, fig.align = "center", out.width = "560px")
st <- meteo_station_info("paris-montsouris")
h7 <- meteo_hourly(st$id, from = Sys.Date() - 7)
daily <- meteo_daily(setNames(st$court, st$id), 400)
last30 <- dplyr::filter(daily, date > Sys.Date() - 30)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(st$lieu, " · station ", st$id, "\n\n", meteo_now_md(h7), "\n", sep = "")
```

# 7 derniers jours, heure par heure

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 9.5}
meteo_plot_hours(h = h7, title = "Paris-Montsouris — 7 derniers jours", detail = TRUE)
```

# 30 derniers jours

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 6}
meteo_plot_days(last30, "Paris-Montsouris — 30 derniers jours")
```

# Par rapport à l'an dernier

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3.8}
meteo_plot_vs_last_year(daily, 30, paste("30 derniers jours vs mêmes jours en", format(Sys.Date() - 365, "%Y")))
```

# 12 derniers mois

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 6}
meteo_plot_year(daily, "Paris-Montsouris — 12 derniers mois")
```

# Tableaux

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Heure par heure, 7 derniers jours

```{r}
meteo_table_hours(h7)
```
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Jour par jour, 30 derniers jours

```{r}
meteo_table_days(last30)
```
